## Goal
- Execute the IVX Autonomous Execution Program: raise enterprise readiness 4/10 → 9/10 via 8 autonomous workstreams, 2-hourly structured reports, and a native iOS Owner Command Center dashboard app (currently being built), continuing owner login recovery blockers.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Program report every cycle must contain 14 numbered items (tasks completed/in progress/blocked, commits, files, tests passed/failed, deployments, bugs, regressions, security, performance, remaining criticals, next priorities) — no narrative-only updates
- 8 dedicated workers (W1 Auth/Security, W2 Mobile, W3 Backend/DB, W4 Chat/Reels/Media, W5 Performance, W6 QA, W7 Deployment/CI/CD, W8 Architecture/Debt); each needs backlog, current task, blocker, ETA, evidence, approval status
- Owner approval required ONLY for: prod schema changes, destructive DB actions, credential rotation, DNS, payments, prod releases, rollback — everything else autonomous
- Dashboard must show workers, job states, PRs, commits, deployments, APK/iOS builds, prod/DB health, security/QA status, module completion, readiness score, progress bars, evidence links; screenshot after each major update
- Success measured by eliminated bugs, stability, verified coverage, evidence-backed completion — not report count
- SECURITY: never print/persist/log passwords; owner sets new password via official Supabase reset email only; never paste password into chat
- Only real mobile login path counts as proof: `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({email, password})`
- Owner token expires ~15 min — refresh via `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login`; stored in `/tmp/owner_token`
- Backend repo-write actions via `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with confirmTexts: `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`, `CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION`
- Use `bun`/`bunx`; Edit tool refuses `package.json` — patch via python3
- Icon prompts: one centered focal symbol, explicit colors/style, opaque background, no text/frames/masks; batch waitTask calls

## Progress
### Done
- **Owner login recovery gated report delivered** (2026-07-17 19:43 UTC): OWNER LOGIN BLOCKED, SESSION REVOCATION VERIFIED, SECURITY ROTATION PARTIAL, APK PARTIAL, DEVICE QA BLOCKED, DEPLOYMENT VERIFIED, FINAL PARTIAL
- **arm64 APK delivered**: `ivx-holdings-v1.4.6-build38-arm64.apk` — stripped x86/x86_64/armeabi-v7a libs via python3 zipfile (zip CLI absent), zipalign -p 16, apksigner signed (debug keystore) + VERIFY_OK; 45,291,665 bytes; SHA-256 `0b7ced1bf419c7cca0b2d8386c2741c1306d6a7ac8d4413a9ce32e65858894c7`; versionCode 38 / 1.4.6 / `com.ivxholdings.app`; only `lib/arm64-v8a/` present
- APK uploaded to `ivx-owner-files/apk-delivery/` (HTTP 200); 7-day signed URL created and given to owner; HEAD 200 content-length match; probe files cleaned up (3× DELETE 200)
- Old exposed password re-proven rejected: `error_code=invalid_credentials`, `token_issued=False`
- Session revocation VERIFIED earlier: local/global logout 204 → refresh 400 / access 403; admin per-user logout 404 unsupported
- Passwordless conflict removed & deployed: commits `6e011658` (client self-heal removal), `3e221781` (owner-access-repair → HTTP 410)
- Production verified: GitHub HEAD == Render deploy `dep-d9d7vrm1a83c738h6gqg` (srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0) == `/health` sha `aab9661d1778`
- Bundle secret scan PASSED: 1 JWT total (anon role), zero service-role/session tokens
- `expo/android/gradle.properties` reverted to full `reactNativeArchitectures` list after arm64 build (git checkout)
- **Command Center iOS app scaffolded** at `ios-ivx-command-center` (Swift/SwiftUI, `createApp`); icon generation scheduled (generationId `i7lkd905h79klkyt1sari`, not yet awaited)
- Written: Theme, models (Worker, Job, Deployment, BuildArtifact, ReadinessMetric, ApprovalItem, SecurityFinding, CommitRecord, ProgramSnapshot), SeedData (Report #1 with real session evidence, 8 workers, 20 jobs, 9 readiness metrics, 6 security findings, 5 approvals, 4 alerts), HealthService (live probe of `https://api.ivxholding.com/health`, decodes `seniorDeveloperRuntime.commitSha`), DashboardViewModel (@Observable), components (StatusPill, ProgressBarView, ScoreRing, MetricTile, SectionHeader), DashboardView

### In Progress
- Building remaining Command Center views: Workers detail, Jobs list, Deployments/Builds, Security/Approvals tabs; replace placeholder `ContentView.swift` with TabView wiring
- Then: `waitTask` for icon, `runChecks` on `ios-ivx-command-center`, capture dashboard screenshot, produce Report #1 in 14-item format

### Blocked
- **Password reset email**: `/auth/v1/recover` HTTP 429 `over_email_send_rate_limit` continuously 18:31 → 19:43 UTC despite 25+ retries — Supabase hourly email quota never cleared; no reset email sent yet
- Service-role key rotation: owner Supabase-dashboard action; old key still valid + in Git history
- Physical Android QA (20-test auth + 30-test device matrices): owner's phone required
- CI workflow registration: `github_commit_file`/`github_dispatch_workflow` → HTTP 404 (token lacks workflow scope; workflows live under `expo/.github/workflows/`, not repo root); workflow authored locally at `.github/workflows/build-apk-release.yml` uncommitted
- `supabase_execute_sql` (raise bucket >50MB for universal APK): backend missing `SUPABASE_DB_URL`/`DATABASE_URL`
- Sandbox env UNSET: AWS creds, GITHUB_TOKEN, RENDER_API_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY

## Key Decisions
- Delivered arm64-only APK (45.3MB) to fit the ~50MB storage object limit (40MB probe OK, 82–86MB → 413); universal 85.9MB build (`/tmp/ivx-holdings-v1.4.6-build38.apk`, SHA `931a1927…2908`) held until bucket limit raised
- python3 zipfile used to strip ABIs since `zip` CLI unavailable; re-sign after zipalign
- Release signed with debug keystore (`expo/android/app/debug.keystore`, pass `android`, alias `androiddebugkey`) — flagged; real release keystore requires owner approval
- User-JWT `logout?scope=global` is the documented revocation method (admin endpoint 404 on this GoTrue)
- Owner Dashboard implemented as native Swift iOS app (`ios-ivx-command-center`), dark-ops theme, seeded with real Report #1 evidence + live /health probe
- Readiness scores in seed: security 4→6, mobile 4→5, traceability 6→8, QA 3→4, enterprise 4→5 (target 9)

## Next Steps
1. Finish Command Center views + TabView in `ContentView.swift`; `waitTask` icon `i7lkd905h79klkyt1sari`; `runChecks` on `ios-ivx-command-center`; screenshot dashboard
2. Deliver Report #1 in mandated 14-item format with worker table + evidence
3. Keep retrying `/auth/v1/recover` (quota should clear in ~30–60 min); on HTTP 200, notify owner to complete reset
4. Owner actions pending: install APK from signed URL, complete reset email flow, rotate service-role key (then verify old key 401), grant GitHub workflow scope, provide `SUPABASE_DB_URL`
5. Advance autonomous backlogs: QA matrices as executable checklists (W6), mock-removal inventory (W8), API latency baselines (W5), permanent ABI splits in Gradle (W5)

- Build tools: `/opt/android-sdk/build-tools/35.0.0/` (apksigner, zipalign, aapt2); Gradle build workaround: watchman shim `/tmp/nowatchman/watchman` in PATH
- arm64 build command: `-PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a` (or edit gradle.properties line 31 — currently reverted to full list)
